newsitem.title: UK: Ulster Unionist leader to see UK's Blair Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Ulster Unionist leader to see UK's Blair Thursday.

text.p: David Trimble, leader of Northern Ireland's largest Protestant Party, will meet Prime Minister Tony Blair later on Thursday following his party's withdrawal from a session of Northern Ireland's peace talks.
A spokeswoman in the Ulster Unionist Party's parliamentary office said she could not say as yet at what time the meeting will take place.
Trimble's party walked out of the talks in Belfast on Wednesday along with representatives of two smaller Protestant parties, the Democratic Unionists and the U.K. unionists.
The move was in protest at what they said was a failure by the British government to answer their questions about proposals for the surrender of guerrilla weapons.
